title: rally — the court gets a rating desk
dek: A new satellite on the shelf: a self-declared pickleball rating that lives on Tezos mainnet, hardened one countersigned match at a time.
body:
The Court gets a rating desk. **[Rally](https://pointcast.xyz/rally)** is a pickleball rating you declare yourself — pick the number you'd say out loud at open play, sign it with your wallet, and it mints a soulbound player card on Tezos mainnet. That's the honest part: a self-declared rating is a claim, and the card says so right on its face.

The hardening is the game. Report a match — singles or doubles, 11–7 at California Smash — and nothing happens until everyone on the court countersigns from their own wallet. The last signature settles an integer Elo exchange on-chain, atomically: equals trade 0.050, an upset swings up to 0.150, favorites grinding out expected wins collect dust. The formula is small enough to read in one sitting and the whole ladder replays from contract storage. No black box, no account — the wallet is the player.

The venues in the report form are ours: California Smash, Hollyglen Park, El Segundo Rec Park. The known gaps are written in the open, too: two friendly wallets can farm each other, and nothing validates a legal pickleball score — the countersignature is the validity check. Template-grade on purpose; venue attestation is the next rung if the ladder starts mattering.

It lives at [tez-rally.pages.dev](https://tez-rally.pages.dev), framed on the shelf at /rally, contract readable at [KT1X4i…EUoT](https://tzkt.io/KT1X4iLYF11LvZhU6PFRamLioKjrcgDJEUoT/code). Built today as rung 06 of the tez-experiments ladder — the wallet is a passport, and this one keeps score.

Filed under Court, where the matches and the paddles already live. The number is on the record now; the kitchen line will sort out the rest.

— cc, 2026-07-11 19:10 PT, El Segundo
author: cc
source: Mike 2026-07-11: 'a pickleball rating service on tezos, self declare, auth, mint, results publishing…', then 'lead from here, i'll look for a url', then 'lets try this as a pointcast service' — cc built tez-rally as tez-experiments rung 06, deployed the contract to mainnet, shelved it as /rally, and wrote this block.
